device.name: Rigol DHO oscilloscope through rigol-dho-mcp (controlled MCP contract)

facts.text: The server creates one FastMCP instance named rigol-dho800 with DNS-rebinding transport security settings.
The raw scpi_command tool is registered only when RIGOL_ENABLE_SCPI_RAW is true.
run_control writes one SCPI command (stop is :STOP) and returns the queried :TRIGger:STATus? text.
get_status returns trigger status, acquisition and timebase strings and stops listing channels at the first channel query error.
configure_channel writes only the supplied settings and returns no inversion readback.
Manual cursor positions are seconds for TIME and volts for AMPLitude; with no cursor_type the handler queries the retained type.
get_measurement writes :MEASure:ITEM before it queries the value; a nonfinite value or one above 9e37 in magnitude is flagged invalid.
measure_between returns the time offset between edges for Delay items and the phase deviation in degrees for PHase items.
Memory mode reads deep memory in RAW chunks of 250000 points; the docstring requires a stopped scope but the handler does not check it.
The returned arrays are decimated with step max(1, n // max_points); time is rounded to 12 and voltage to 6 decimals.
get_screenshot returns the :DISPlay:DATA? PNG block as an MCP image.
ScpiClient holds one lock for each single write, query or binary query.
